notes.restructure: placement-only writes are recordable (list [reference layer, enumerated place.<mode>, reference anchor?]); a restructure with a create payload (layer record + graph operation) is not replayable from the recorded value types: not recorded, reported not_recordable reason restructure_create_payload
notes.replay_transaction: each replayed step is its own chronicle revision through the same public Run method; atomicity is rollback (newest-first undo of applied steps, redo history restored) and ONE group history step 'action <name>'; a chronicle-level single transaction is NOT_PROVEN
notes.content_digest: no public raw-bytes sha256 in harness-core's non-optional dependencies (package::sha256_hex_of is behind feature import); the receipt digest comes from Session::stage_tile on the opened input (sha256 of the input bytes, staged body not referenced so never saved); an input that fails to open has no digest (digest_note input_not_opened)
notes.job_scope_resource: JobScope.resource needs an Accord DomainId; no job-level prefix exists, so admission uses the opened document's SDOC id and follows the open (before automation and outputs). Not a missing port API.
